content:
watchOS 27 is the latest major system update for Apple Watch, adding three brand new apps to your watch alongside several new features.

#1: Siri

Siri has received a major AI overhaul in watchOS 27, and one part of that is a brand new Siri app.

The Siri app is available for iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Vision Pro, and also Apple Watch.

watchOS 27 still lets you invoke Siri via the digital crown, but this app is another avenue through which you can start conversations. More importantly, you can scroll through past conversation history within the app.

Siri AI is more conversational than the old assistant, and it keeps a record of past queries across all your devices. So the Siri app in watchOS 27 doesn't just show conversations from your Apple Watch — it also includes content from your iPhone, Mac, and other devices.

#2: Find My

Alongside the new features iOS 27 brings to the Find My app, Apple has also reimagined the Find My experience on watchOS this year.

In watchOS 26, Find My was split into three separate apps: "Find Devices," "Find Items," and "Find People."

But in watchOS 27, Apple has streamlined all find functions into one brand new, unified "Find My" app.

Find My on Apple Watch offers all the functionality of the previous three apps, but in a more streamlined experience, making it easy to find any item or person through a map-centric interface.

You can switch between different search targets via the menu in the upper-left corner; apart from that, the interface is consistent.

#3: Readiness

If you own an Apple Watch Series 12 or Apple Watch Ultra 4, watchOS 27 adds a third app: Readiness.

Here's the App Store's description of what the Readiness app does:

The Readiness app analyzes your recent activity, vitals, and sleep data to help you understand your state for the day ahead. Features: Get a score and a clear status classification, including "Recover," "Pace Yourself," "Ready," or "Go For It." View explanations of contributing factors, with tappable links to jump to related apps. New complications and Smart Stack widgets make it easy to check at a glance. View more details in the Fitness app on iPhone.

In short, Readiness gives you an at-a-glance overview of your overall vitals, so you can see how rested and prepared your body is for the day.

What do you think of these brand new Apple Watch apps in watchOS 27? Let us know in the comments section.
